description: Build the upload locally, run tday.com's own checks and the secret scan (patterns plus every value in this repo's .env files), and write a local review page listing every image, string and file, with a confirmation code. A clean review is the gate: upload with its code straight away, no need to ask the developer; tell them where the review page is. redact="blocking" blanks blocking findings in the DOM and paints over them in the screenshot.
name: capture_review
title: Review what would be uploaded
